evals.prompt: Memory compression is now enabled. Migrate the existing uncompressed memories in memories/.
evals.expected_output: The assistant reads .crux/crux-memories.json, finds uncompressed memories over the minimum size, compresses them, and archives the sources to the configured archive directory.
assertions: The assistant reads compression settings from `.crux/crux-memories.json`
Only memories at or above `compressionMinLines` are compressed
Original sources are archived to the configured `compressionSourceArchive` directory

evals.prompt: Decompress memories/core/api-conventions.md so I can read it.
evals.expected_output: The assistant shows the memory in readable form without overwriting the compressed file unless asked.
assertions: The assistant decompresses the CRUX body into readable text
The compressed memory file is not overwritten unless the user asks
